objective: Drive interest and website visits for the KingSong S16 Pro electric unicycle, highlighting its off-road capabilities and powerful performance.
persona_rationale: The KingSong S16 Pro's high price, robust off-road features, powerful motor, and specialized nature align perfectly with the weekend explorer's desire for performance and build quality.
key_message: The KingSong S16 Pro is built for powerful rides and conquering varied terrain, offering serious capability for weekend adventures.

proof_points.claim: Harness 3000W rated power and a 48° gradability for steep climbs and demanding trails.
Take on any surface with ease thanks to its rugged 16-inch all-terrain tire.
proof_points.source: description: 'Take on any surface with ease thanks to KingSong S16’s rugged 16-inch all-terrain tire'

proof_points.claim: Experience unparalleled stability with 88 mm of dustproof X-Type suspension travel.
proof_points.source: description: 'Experience unparalleled stability and sleek design with KingSong S16’s dustproof X-Type suspension'; specs: 'Suspension Travel: 88 mm'

proof_points.claim: Extend your adventures with up to 130 km range on a free wheel from its 1480 Wh battery.
proof_points.source: description: 'Extend your adventures with KingSong S16’s 1480 Wh battery, providing a 130 km range on a free wheel.'

success_metric: Website clicks to product page and engagement rate (likes, shares, comments).
